description: Header file declaring format conversion utilities for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, including classes for pixel and vertex formats, and a format table.

classes.name: FormatBase
classes.description: Base structure for format information, including format IDs and comparison operators.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents a pixel format with methods to validate and retrieve internal formats.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Represents a vertex format with Metal-specific format and load function.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Manages collections of pixel and vertex formats, providing initialization and retrieval functions.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two FormatBase objects based on format IDs.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two FormatBase objects.

methods.name: actualAngleFormat
methods.description: Returns the actual angle format associated with the format.

methods.name: intendedAngleFormat
methods.description: Returns the intended angle format associated with the format.

methods.name: FormatRenderable
methods.description: Checks if a given MTLPixelFormat is renderable.

methods.name: FormatCPUReadable
methods.description: Checks if a given MTLPixelFormat is CPU-readable.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Format or VertexFormat with specific format IDs and display info.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the FormatTable with display-specific formats.

methods.name: generateTextureCaps
methods.description: Generates texture capabilities and compressed formats based on display.

methods.name: getPixelFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the pixel format for a given angle format ID.

methods.name: getVertexFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the vertex format for a given angle format ID, considering packing.
